candidates.change_summary: Removed the onlyAdmin modifier from setOwner so any caller can set owner (changes observable owner after setOwner).
Changed the access check in onlyAdmin to require msg.sender == owner instead of admin so owner (not admin) can call setOwner, altering post-call owner when invoked by owner.
Change setOwner to return false after setting owner (returns different boolean).

Change setOwner to return negation of the original true literal by returning (_owner == owner) (will return true only when _owner equals previous owner after assignment), altering returned value in general.

Modify onlyAdmin modifier to invert the require condition so it allows non-admins and rejects the admin, changing whether setOwner call proceeds and thus can change returned value by causing revert vs non-revert; to keep both P and M non-reverting for the selected call, we instead change the require error message only (no behavior) — but that wouldn't change return value, so instead we remove the require to allow anyone to call; this changes who can call but keeps setOwner executing and returning true/false accordingly, potentially changing observed return when caller is not admin. Here we remove the require so setOwner will execute regardless of msg.sender.

Insert an explicit return true before completing the function, making function return early true and ignoring any later code (here placed after assignment, but as the only return it matches signature); this is equivalent to original but kept as a distinct single-statement insertion that returns true — however to change behavior we insert return true before assignment to return old value instead of new; we insert a return true before owner assignment so the function returns true without changing owner.
Removed the onlyAdmin check from setOwner so any caller can change owner (replaced modifier invocation with no modifier).
Tightened onlyAdmin to require msg.sender equals owner instead of admin, so the admin check behavior changes and setOwner calls by admin may revert if admin != owner.
